historical_artifact_rule: Artifacts registered as historical/noninferential remain reproducibility history only and cannot support confirmatory type-I, coverage, primary power, quota freeze, or W0 authorization.
next_scientific_gate: Choose and validate a design-based/cluster-aware primary FNR/FPR procedure; then run boundary type-I/coverage calibration and joint power under meaningful alternatives; only then derive numeric quotas/minima/caps and terminal rules.
